gr_1.speaker: Narration
gr_1.text: The shop is packed. Fluorescent hum, a cart with a bad wheel, and somewhere near the till a voice is getting louder.

gr_prep.speaker: Narration
gr_prep.text: The list is short, but the noise is a lot. How to go in?

choices.text: Steady and slow — breathe, one aisle at a time.
In and out fast — beat the crowd before it grows.

gr_into.speaker: Narration
gr_into.text: The argument at the till sharpens. Carts jostle. Who can keep their footing in all this?

gr_strong.speaker: Iris
gr_strong.text: She lets the noise wash past, picks her line through the crowd, and is back out before it ever gets to her.

gr_ok.speaker: June
gr_ok.text: She gets it done, though the raised voices leave her a little rattled by the end.

gr_strain.speaker: Rowan
gr_strain.text: He pushes through it, but the chaos isn't his element — it costs him more than it should.

gr_done.speaker: Narration
gr_done.text: Bags in hand, out into the quiet of the street. Done.
